
Author: SilverStone Technology

ST85F-GS

ST85F-GS

- Compact design with a depth of 140mm for easy integration (V2.0)
- Compact design with a depth of 150mm for easy integration (V1.0)
- Strict ±2.5% voltage regulation and low ripple & noise (V2.0)
- Strict ±3% voltage regulation and low ripple & noise (V1.0)
- 24/7 continuous power output with 40℃ operating temperature
- 80 PLUS Gold certification
- 100% modular cables
- Class-leading single +12V rail
- Silent running 120mm fan with 18dBA minimum

 

VERSION

| (1) Designed for 80 PLUS Gold level of efficiency to reduce wasted heat and save on electricity. | (2) Regulation and low ripple & noise performance for high stability. |
| --- | --- |
| | |
| (3) 100% modular cable design for use with short cable kit such as SilverStone’s PP05-E for easy removal in a case with cable routed and tied down. | (4) 140mm depth sets new standard for high wattage PSUs with modular cables. |
| | |
| (5) Built-in 120mm fan has excellent airflow and low noise, perfect for quiet home or office use. | (6) Strider Gold S PSUs are the first power supply models in the world to include flat 24pin cables. This cable offer much greater flexibility for tighter folding and superior cable management. |
| | |
| (7) Powerful single +12V rail design, perfect for future high-end component upgrades or overclocking. | |
| | |

Product Specifications

Product No. SST-ST85F-GS

Color Black (lead-free paint)

Max. DC Output 850W

Power density V1: 439W per liter V2: 471W per liter

MTBF 100,000 hours
